spec.description: Retrieve (or generate a new) deposit address for a particular asset and method. Requires the `Funds permissions - Query` API key permission.

aclass.description: Asset class (optional). Only `currency` is broadly used today; `tokenized_asset` covers xstocks-style tokenized equities.

new.description: Whether or not to generate a new address.

amount.description: Amount you wish to deposit (only required for `method=Bitcoin Lightning`).

response.title: DepositAddressesFrame
response.description: Wire frame; the generated method returns `result`.

error.description: Wire envelope field; see the core.

result.description: Deposit addresses for the requested asset and method.

items.title: DepositAddress
items.description: One deposit address for a particular asset and method.

expiretm.description: Expiration time as a unix timestamp, or `0` if not expiring.

new.description: Whether or not the address has ever been used.

tag.description: Destination tag for XRP deposit addresses, or memo for STX/XLM/EOS deposit addresses.

memo.description: Memo for some deposit addresses (seen alongside `tag` in Kraken's own documented example response, though this property is not declared on the upstream schema -- see this endpoint's `notes`).

notes: Upstream `requestBody` requires `nonce`; dropped from this schema since the core's `authed_request` (`core/transport/http.py`) injects a strictly-increasing nonce into every private call automatically -- it is never a caller-supplied parameter, matching the existing hand-written `deposit_methods(self, asset)` signature, which takes none.
Upstream declares `amount` with `oneOf` (string/integer/number); rewritten as `anyOf` per spec-authoring rule 4 (`oneOf`/`allOf` raise `NotImplementedError` in the parser).

Upstream's documented example response includes an entry with a `memo` property (`{"address": "krakenkraken", "expiretm": "0", "memo": "4150096490"}`), but the `address` component schema only declares `address`/`expiretm`/`new`/`tag` -- `memo` is not a declared property, even though `tag`'s own description says it "contains tags for XRP... and memos for STX, XLM, and EOS deposit addresses". Added `memo` as an optional property to match the documented example rather than silently drop a field the venue is shown to actually return.
